issues.quote: Monnier had made us all show our watches, as he does every year, and told me my case wanted cleaning and my hands were a disgrace.
issues.fact: The fact sheet says nothing about the watches being checked, compared, or set against any other clock at dinner.
issues.misreading: A solver could read this as implying that Girard's watch was inspected and found to be off, or that it was synchronised with the others, which would make his readings unreliable or adjusted. The sheet gives no information about the watch's accuracy. This is a minor hint and does not change any stated reading.
